method: PARAPHRASED AND HASH-ANCHORED from European Hematology Association, HemaSphere 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up' (published 23 June 2026). Every claim is a paraphrase backed by anchors (scripts/anchor.py): verify.py --source re-finds each anchored span in a fresh copy of the source, checks the claim's numbers against it and rejects copying. LICENCE: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (read at Europe PMC fullTextXML <license> element for PMC13288861). The source's words are NOT reproduced here.

claims.claim: **Diagnose from an excisional node biopsy where possible,** a core biopsy otherwise; fine-needle aspiration is not enough.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Allocate risk group from PET/CT staging plus clinical risk factors;** skip marrow biopsy when a baseline PET/CT is done, and do an interim PET/CT whenever the chosen pathway uses it. Offer fertility counselling before treatment to anyone who may want children.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Early-stage favourable: two cycles of ABVD, then 20 Gy involved-site radiotherapy** (1A), whatever the interim PET shows.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Dropping radiotherapy costs some disease control** even when the interim PET is negative. It can still be discussed after complete metabolic response (Deauville 3 or less) if late radiation risks outweigh the benefit, judged by a radiation oncologist; then follow the chemotherapy-only schedules from RAPID, H10F or HD16.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Early-stage unfavourable, age 60 or under: '2 + 2'** (two cycles of escalated BEACOPP then two of ABVD), with 30 Gy involved-site radiotherapy only if the end-of-chemotherapy PET is positive (1A). Swapping in eBEACOPDac or another procarbazine-free variant is an alternative (4A).
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **If a less intensive route without escalated BEACOPP is preferred:** four ABVD cycles, then involved-site radiotherapy to 30 Gy (1A). Escalating to escalated BEACOPP for a positive PET after two ABVD cycles is for selected patients only, as its advantage had gone by 10 years.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Bleomycin lung toxicity:** over 60, give bleomycin in two cycles at most; over 70, consider leaving it out (3A). Dropping bleomycin after cycle two reduces short-term lung toxicity (RATHL).
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Age 60 or under: BrECADD for four cycles if the PET after two cycles is negative, six if positive,** then PET-guided radiotherapy (1A). It beat escalated BEACOPP on 5-year PFS (93.6% vs 90.6%) with less toxicity, neuropathy and infertility.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Where an ABVD-type approach is preferred, six cycles of nivolumab-AVD** are the alternative for younger patients (1A); its 3-year PFS was 91% against 82% for brentuximab-AVD. Without targeted agents, interim-PET-guided eBEACOPDac is an option (4A).
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **BrECADD, escalated BEACOPP, eBEACOPDac and brentuximab-AVD cause frequent neutropenia and febrile neutropenia:** primary G-CSF and cotrimoxazole prophylaxis are mandatory.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Partial remission on PET after systemic therapy:** consider 30 Gy involved-site radiotherapy with modern planning.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Over 60 and fit for multi-agent chemotherapy: six cycles of nivolumab-AVD** (2A). In this group it gave 3-year PFS of 82% versus 58% with brentuximab-AVD.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Older patients without access to targeted agents:** up to two cycles of A(B)VD, then four of AVD (3A). More than two cycles with bleomycin cause unacceptable lung toxicity at this age.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Older patients unfit for multi-agent chemotherapy:** options are limited and cure is unlikely; consider brentuximab paired with dacarbazine or with PD-1 blockade, or one conventional cytotoxic drug (3B).
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Definitions:** refractory means progression on treatment or relapse within 3 months of finishing; early relapse is within 12 months; late relapse is 12 months or more. Confirm relapse by biopsy where possible (3A).
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **High-dose chemotherapy with autograft is standard for most eligible patients** (2A); age alone does not exclude, and selected fit patients over 65 qualify. Aim for complete metabolic response first: 5-year PFS is about 75% with it versus 25% to 30% without.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Salvage before autograft:** where PD-1 inhibitors are available and funded, combine one with chemotherapy, together or in sequence (3B). Otherwise, brentuximab-naive patients get brentuximab plus chemotherapy (2A). BEAM is the standard conditioning; collect stem cells early.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Brentuximab maintenance after autograft for high-risk patients** (1A), up to 16 doses. High risk means primary refractory disease, early relapse or extranodal disease at relapse; 5-year PFS rose to 59% from 41%.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Relapse after autograft, PD-1-naive: give PD-1 blockade, for a maximum of 2 years.** Judge first response after four cycles using LYRIC criteria so pseudo-progression does not end treatment early.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Discuss allogeneic transplant** with eligible responders (3B) and with fit patients refractory to PD-1 therapy (3A). ⚠️ Stop the PD-1 inhibitor at least 6 weeks before the allograft.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Not eligible for autograft: single-agent PD-1 inhibitor is preferred** (2A). If PD-1 inhibitors are unsuitable or unfunded, give brentuximab alone for up to 16 cycles, especially if brentuximab-naive (2A).
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **After end-of-treatment imaging, follow clinically;** routine surveillance scans are not indicated without symptoms. Check TSH yearly after neck radiotherapy, and blood pressure and lipids yearly for everyone.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Breast screening after chest radiotherapy before age 36:** yearly mammography and/or breast MRI from 8 years after radiotherapy, but not before age 25.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **NLPHL stage IA without risk factors: 30 Gy involved-site radiotherapy alone** (2A). Brentuximab and PD-1 inhibitors have no role in NLPHL (5A), because the tumour cells lack CD30.
claims.locator: European Hematology Association, HemaSphere, 'Hodgkin lymphoma: EHA Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up', published 23 June 2026, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13288861/, retrieved 2026-09-23
